FX-4CG-001.says: The settings as they start: yellow at the top-left, (10, 10) per cent, green at the top-right, (90, 10), magenta at the bottom-left, (10, 90), and blue at the bottom-right, (90, 90), blend 100, opacity 100, normal: the cel is painted over with the four colours running into each other, each strongest at its own corner, the line and the shadow gone under it, every pixel at its own covering, and the empty pixels empty.

FX-4CG-002.says: Blend 1: each pixel all but wholly its nearest point's colour, four quarters meeting at hard seams down the middle and across it.

FX-4CG-003.says: Blend 1000: the four colours mixed nearly evenly, the whole cel close to one colour.

FX-4CG-004.says: Point 1 at (28.125, 25) per cent, the centre of the pixel in column 4 and row 2: that pixel is yellow exactly.

FX-4CG-005.says: Opacity 50: the colours laid on at half strength over the cel.

FX-4CG-007.says: Blending mode multiply: the cel darkened and tinted by the colours, the line still showing through.

FX-4CG-008.says: Blending mode screen: the cel lightened by the colours, none darkened.

FX-4CG-009.says: Blending mode add: the colours added to the cel.

FX-4CG-010.says: Colours written in capitals, #FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF and #FFFFFF: red, green, blue and white.

FX-4CG-011.says: All four colours #6450a0: every pixel that shows is #6450a0 at its own covering, wherever the points are.

FX-4CG-012.says: All four points at (50, 50): every pixel as far from each, so every pixel is the four colours mixed evenly.

FX-4CG-013.says: Point 1 keyed from (10, 10) at frame 0 to (90, 90) at frame 4, linear: the yellow slides across the cel; frame 0 is FX-4CG-001.

FX-4CG-014.says: Blend keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 1000, is held at 1000, and is blend 1000.

FX-4CG-015.says: FX-4CG-001 moved three pixels right: the colours move with the drawing.

FX-4CG-016.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the points are the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-4CG-001's.

FX-4CG-017.says: The points outside the drawing, at (-100, -100), (200, -100), (-100, 200) and (200, 200): the colours mix more evenly across the cel than FX-4CG-001.

FX-4CG-018.says: Blend 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-019.says: Blend 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-020.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-021.says: Opacity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-022.says: Point 3 1001 per cent across, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-023.says: Colour 2 "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-024.says: Colour 4 "blue", a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-025.says: Blending mode "darken", which is not "normal", "multiply", "screen" or "add". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-4CG-026.says: Opacity keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
